<div class="card-body">
'''Kitik Keed'kak''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">キティック・キードカック</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">クオサグの過保護な母、「カルファルニル・シンドロス」と同じ位置カードにいたならば、即座にロストする。宇宙戦闘機や密閉型のビークルには搭乗できない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-183o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">昆虫人ヤムリルの女性。体力は強靭で、気が短い。身を隠す技に長け、技術屋としての腕もいい。肉食で、卵が好物。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Kitik Keed'kak.

'''Card text:''' Immediately lost if at the same site as Kal'Falnl C'ndros, Quosag's overprotective mother. Cannot board starfighters or enclosed vehicles.

'''Lore:''' A female Yam'rii insectoid. Very strong and short-tempered. Skilled at hiding and technically capable. Meat eater; likes eggs.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Kitik Keed'kak]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
